/* selectProgramHistoryTotalCount - Park Kyuyoung */
SELECT
COUNT(*) AS CNT
FROM SAB101 WHERE 1=1
AND PROGRM_NM LIKE '%' || #{PROGRM_NM} || '%'
AND UNT_SYS_SE_CD LIKE '%' || #{UNT_SYS_SE_CD} || '%'
AND URL_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{URL_ADDR} || '%'
AND PROGRM_USE_SE_CD LIKE '%' || #{PROGRM_USE_SE_CD} || '%'
AND DATAA_CHG_SE_CD LIKE '%' || #{DATAA_CHG_SE_CD} || '%'
AND MDFCN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')

/* selectProgramHistory - Park Kyuyoung */
SELECT
D.PROGRM_ID, D.UNT_SYS_SE_CD, D.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, D.PROGRM_NM, D.OUTSD_PROGRM_YN, D.URL_ADDR, D.PROGRM_USE_SE_CD, D.RM_CN, D.FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(D.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, D.LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(D.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT, TO_CHAR(D.MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MDFCN_DT
FROM SAB101 D /* 프로그램 이력 */ WHERE 1=1
AND PROGRM_NM LIKE '%' || #{PROGRM_NM} || '%'
AND UNT_SYS_SE_CD LIKE '%' || #{UNT_SYS_SE_CD} || '%'
AND URL_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{URL_ADDR} || '%'
AND PROGRM_USE_SE_CD LIKE '%' || #{PROGRM_USE_SE_CD} || '%'
AND DATAA_CHG_SE_CD LIKE '%' || #{DATAA_CHG_SE_CD} || '%'
AND MDFCN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
ORDER BY MDFCN_DT DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

/* selectMenuHistoryTotalCount - Park Kyuyoung */
SELECT
COUNT(*) AS CNT
FROM ( SELECT D.MENU_NO AS MENU_NO /* 메뉴번호 */ , D.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD AS DATAA_CHG_SE_CD /* 데이터변경구분코드 */ , D.MENU_NM AS MENU_NM /* 메뉴명 */ , D.UP_MENU_ID /* 상위메뉴아이디 */ AS UP_MENU_ID , D.MENU_LEVELA_NO /* 메뉴레벨번호 */ AS MENU_LEVELA_NO , D.PROGRM_ID /* 프로그램아이디 */ AS PROGRM_ID , C.URL_ADDR /* URL 주소 */ AS URL_ADDR , D.RM_CN /* 비고내용 */ AS RM_CN , D.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID , TO_CHAR(D.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT , D.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID , TO_CHAR(D.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT , D.MDFCN_DT AS MDFCN_DT , NVL(D.LAST_MDFR_ID, D.FRST_RGTR_ID) AS WORKER , ( SELECT E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAB200 E /* 메뉴 */ WHERE E.MENU_NO = D.MENU_NO ) AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD
FROM SAB201 D /* 메뉴이력 */ JOIN SAB100 C /* 프로그램 */ ON D.PROGRM_ID = C.PROGRM_ID ) E
AND E.MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NM} || '%'
AND E.UP_MENU_ID LIKE '%' || #{UP_MENU_ID} || '%'
AND E.URL_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{URL_ADDR} || '%'
AND E.RM_CN LIKE '%' || #{RM_CN} || '%'
AND E.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD LIKE '%' || #{DATAA_CHG_SE_CD} || '%'
AND E.MDFCN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND E.MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}
AND E.LAST_MDFR_ID LIKE '%' || #{WORKER} || '%'

/* selectMenuHistory - Park Kyuyoung */
SELECT
MENU_NO , DATAA_CHG_SE_CD , MENU_NM , UP_MENU_ID , MENU_LEVELA_NO , PROGRM_ID , URL_ADDR , RM_CN , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT , MDFCN_DT , WORKER , UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD
FROM ( SELECT D.MENU_NO AS MENU_NO /* 메뉴번호 */ , D.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD AS DATAA_CHG_SE_CD /* 데이터변경구분코드 */ , D.MENU_NM AS MENU_NM /* 메뉴명 */ , D.UP_MENU_ID /* 상위메뉴아이디 */ AS UP_MENU_ID , D.MENU_LEVELA_NO /* 메뉴레벨번호 */ AS MENU_LEVELA_NO , D.PROGRM_ID /* 프로그램아이디 */ AS PROGRM_ID , C.URL_ADDR /* URL 주소 */ AS URL_ADDR , D.RM_CN /* 비고내용 */ AS RM_CN , D.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID , TO_CHAR(D.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT , D.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID , TO_CHAR(D.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT , D.MDFCN_DT AS MDFCN_DT , NVL(D.LAST_MDFR_ID, D.FRST_RGTR_ID) AS WORKER , ( SELECT E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAB200 E /* 메뉴 */ WHERE E.MENU_NO = D.MENU_NO ) AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD
FROM SAB201 D /* 메뉴이력 */ JOIN SAB100 C /* 프로그램 */ ON D.PROGRM_ID = C.PROGRM_ID ) E
AND E.MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NM} || '%'
AND E.UP_MENU_ID LIKE '%' || #{UP_MENU_ID} || '%'
AND E.URL_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{URL_ADDR} || '%'
AND E.RM_CN LIKE '%' || #{RM_CN} || '%'
AND E.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD LIKE '%' || #{DATAA_CHG_SE_CD} || '%'
AND E.MDFCN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND E.MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}
AND E.LAST_MDFR_ID LIKE '%' || #{WORKER} || '%'
ORDER BY MDFCN_DT DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

AND D.MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}

/* selectInstituteHistory - Park Kyuyoung */
SELECT
D.INST_NO, D.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, D.INST_NM, D.UP_INST_NO, (SELECT E.INST_NM FROM SAA000 E /* 통합기관 */ WHERE E.INST_NO = D.UP_INST_NO) AS UP_INST_NM, D.INST_TYPE_SE_CD, D.RGN_CD, D.HPGE_URL_ADDR, D.MAIN_ENFC_INST_SE_CD, D.BPLC_ZIP, D.BPLC_PST_ADDR, D.BPLC_DADDR, DEC_B64(D.RPRSV_NM_ENCPT) AS RPRSV_NM_ENCPT, D.RPRS_TELNO, D.RPRS_FXNO, D.APLCN_BGNG_YMD, D.APLCN_END_YMD, DEC_B64(D.PIC_NM_ENCPT) AS PIC_NM_ENCPT, D.PIC_ENFSN_NO, D.PIC_TELNO, DEC_B64(D.PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, DEC_B64(D.PIC_EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS PIC_EML_ADDR_ENCPT, D.CNSGN_YMD, D.APLY_YMD, D.APLCNT_ID, D.APRV_YN, D.RJCT_CS_CN, D.PRCS_YMD, D.AUTZR_ID, D.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO, D.ATFINO, D.CTPV_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, D.SGG_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, D.EMD_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, D.DEL_YN, TO_CHAR(D.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, NVL(D.LAST_MDFR_ID, D.FRST_RGTR_ID) AS WORKER, TO_CHAR(D.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT, TO_CHAR(D.MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MDFCN_DT, E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD
FROM SAA001 D /*통합기관 이력 */ LEFT JOIN SAA000 E /* 통합기관 */ ON E.INST_NO = D.INST_NO WHERE 1=1
AND D.INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{INST_NM} || '%'
AND D.INST_TYPE_SE_CD LIKE '%' || #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD} || '%'
AND D.RGN_CD LIKE '%' || #{RGN_CD} || '%'
AND D.RPRSV_NM_ENCPT LIKE '%' || ENC_B64(#{RPRSV_NM_ENCPT}) || '%'
AND D.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD LIKE '%' || #{DATAA_CHG_SE_CD} || '%'
AND D.MDFCN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND D.MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}
AND D.LAST_MDFR_ID LIKE '%' || #{WORKER} || '%'
ORDER BY MDFCN_DT DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

/* selectOrg - Park Kyuyoung */
SELECT
INST_NO, UP_INST_NO, INST_NM
FROM SAA000 /*통합기관*/

/* selectRightsHistory - Ji-Seob Lee */
SELECT E.AUTHRT_ID, TO_CHAR(E.MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MDFCN_DT, E.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, E.AUTHRT_NM, E.DEL_YN, E.RM_CN, E.INST_TYPE_SE_CD, E.INST_NO, E.INST_NM, E.ENFSN_ROLE_SE_CD, E.SRTNG_SQNCE, E.FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(E.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, E.LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(E.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT, E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, NVL(E.LAST_MDFR_ID, E.FRST_RGTR_ID) AS WORKER
FROM
( SELECT AUTHRT_ID, MDFCN_DT, DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, AUTHRT_NM, DEL_YN, RM_CN, INST_TYPE_SE_CD, INST_NO, (SELECT D.INST_NM FROM SAA000 D /* 통합기관 */ WHERE D.INST_NO = C.INST_NO) AS INST_NM, ENFSN_ROLE_SE_CD, SRTNG_SQNCE, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT, (SELECT D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAA000 D /* 통합기관 */ WHERE D.INST_NO = C.INST_NO) AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD
FROM SAB401 C ) E
AND E.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD = #{DATAA_CHG_SE_CD}
AND E.INST_TYPE_SE_CD = #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD}
AND E.ENFSN_ROLE_SE_CD = #{ENFSN_ROLE_SE_CD}
AND E.RM_CN LIKE '%' || #{RM_CN} || '%'
AND E.AUTHRT_NM LIKE '%' || #{AUTHRT_NM} || '%'
AND E.INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{INST_NM} || '%'
AND E.MDFCN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}
AND E.LAST_MDFR_ID LIKE '%' || #{WORKER} || '%'
ORDER BY E.MDFCN_DT DESC
OFFSET #{OFFSET_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

/* selectRightsHistoryGroupCount - Ji-Seob Lee */
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT
FROM (
SELECT AUTHRT_ID, (SELECT D.AUTHRT_NM FROM SAB400 D /* 권한 */ WHERE D.AUTHRT_ID = C.AUTHRT_ID) AS AUTHRT_NM, MENU_NO, (SELECT D.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 D /* 메뉴 */ WHERE D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS MENU_NM, (SELECT D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAB200 D /* 단위업무구분 */ WHERE D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, ( SELECT F.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 F /* 메뉴 */ WHERE F.MENU_NO = ( SELECT D.MENU_NO FROM SAB200 D WHERE D.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 START WITH D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO CONNECT BY PRIOR D.UP_MENU_NO = D.MENU_NO ) ) AS TOP_MENU_NM,
MDFCN_DT, DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN, REG_BUTTON_USE_YN, MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN, DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN, MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAB301 C
) E
AND E.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD = #{DATAA_CHG_SE_CD}
AND E.AUTHRT_NM LIKE '%' || #{AUTHRT_NM} || '%'
AND E.MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NM} || '%'
AND E.TOP_MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{TOP_MENU_NM} || '%'
AND E.MDFCN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}
AND E.LAST_MDFR_ID LIKE '%' || #{WORKER} || '%'

/* selectRightsHistoryGroup - Ji-Seob Lee */
SELECT E.AUTHRT_ID, E.AUTHRT_NM, E.MENU_NO, E.MENU_NM, E.TOP_MENU_NM, TO_CHAR(E.MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MDFCN_DT, E.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, E.INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.REG_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN, E.FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(E.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, E.LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(E.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT, E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, NVL(E.LAST_MDFR_ID, E.FRST_RGTR_ID) AS WORKER
FROM (
SELECT AUTHRT_ID, (SELECT D.AUTHRT_NM FROM SAB400 D /* 권한 */ WHERE D.AUTHRT_ID = C.AUTHRT_ID) AS AUTHRT_NM, MENU_NO, (SELECT D.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 D /* 메뉴 */ WHERE D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS MENU_NM, (SELECT D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAB200 D /* 단위업무구분 */ WHERE D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, ( SELECT F.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 F /* 메뉴 */ WHERE F.MENU_NO = ( SELECT D.MENU_NO FROM SAB200 D WHERE D.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 START WITH D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO CONNECT BY PRIOR D.UP_MENU_NO = D.MENU_NO ) ) AS TOP_MENU_NM,
MDFCN_DT, DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN, REG_BUTTON_USE_YN, MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN, DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN, MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAB301 C
) E
AND E.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD = #{DATAA_CHG_SE_CD}
AND E.AUTHRT_NM LIKE '%' || #{AUTHRT_NM} || '%'
AND E.MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NM} || '%'
AND E.TOP_MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{TOP_MENU_NM} || '%'
AND E.MDFCN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}
AND E.LAST_MDFR_ID LIKE '%' || #{WORKER} || '%'
ORDER BY E.MDFCN_DT DESC
OFFSET #{OFFSET_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

/* selectRightsHistoryUserMenuCount - Ji-Seob Lee */
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT
FROM
( SELECT C.USER_ID,
CASE WHEN F.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN G.FLNM_ENCPT WHEN H.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '____' || H.INST_NM WHEN F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN I.FLNM_ENCPT ELSE '' END AS USER_NM,
C.MENU_NO,
(SELECT D.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 D /* 메뉴 */ WHERE D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS MENU_NM, (SELECT D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAB200 D /* 메뉴 */ WHERE D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, ( SELECT J.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 J /* 메뉴 */ WHERE J.MENU_NO = ( SELECT D.MENU_NO FROM SAB200 D WHERE D.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 START WITH D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO CONNECT BY PRIOR D.UP_MENU_NO = D.MENU_NO ) ) AS TOP_MENU_NM,
C.MDFCN_DT, C.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, C.INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.REG_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.FRST_RGTR_ID, C.FRST_REG_DT, C.LAST_MDFR_ID, C.LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAB251 C
LEFT JOIN SAA200 F /* 사용자 */ ON F.USER_ID = C.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SCA100 G /* 종사자 */ ON G.ENFSN_NO = F.ENFSN_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 H /* 통합기관 */ ON H.INST_NO = G.OGDP_INST_NO LEFT JOIN SCA200 I /* 청소년보호자 */ ON I.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO
) E
AND E.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD = #{DATAA_CHG_SE_CD}
AND E.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{USER_ID} || '%'
AND (E.USER_NM = ENC_B64(#{USER_NM_ENCPT}) OR E.USER_NM = '____' || #{USER_NM})
AND E.MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NM} || '%'
AND E.TOP_MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{TOP_MENU_NM} || '%'
AND E.MDFCN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}
AND E.LAST_MDFR_ID LIKE '%' || #{WORKER} || '%'

/* selectRightsHistoryUserMenu - Ji-Seob Lee */
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NM, MENU_NO, MENU_NM, TOP_MENU_NM, TO_CHAR(E.MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MDFCN_DT, DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN, REG_BUTTON_USE_YN, MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN, DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN, MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(E.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(E.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT, E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, NVL(LAST_MDFR_ID, FRST_RGTR_ID) AS WORKER FROM
( SELECT C.USER_ID,
CASE WHEN F.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN DEC_B64(G.FLNM_ENCPT) WHEN H.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '____' || H.INST_NM WHEN F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN DEC_B64(I.FLNM_ENCPT) ELSE '' END AS USER_NM,
C.MENU_NO,
(SELECT D.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 D /* 메뉴 */ WHERE D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS MENU_NM, (SELECT D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAB200 D /* 메뉴 */ WHERE D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, ( SELECT J.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 J /* 메뉴 */ WHERE J.MENU_NO = ( SELECT D.MENU_NO FROM SAB200 D WHERE D.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 START WITH D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO CONNECT BY PRIOR D.UP_MENU_NO = D.MENU_NO ) ) AS TOP_MENU_NM,
C.MDFCN_DT, C.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, C.INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.REG_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN, C.FRST_RGTR_ID, C.FRST_REG_DT, C.LAST_MDFR_ID, C.LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAB251 C
LEFT JOIN SAA200 F /* 사용자 */ ON F.USER_ID = C.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SCA100 G /* 종사자 */ ON G.ENFSN_NO = F.ENFSN_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 H /* 통합기관 */ ON H.INST_NO = G.OGDP_INST_NO LEFT JOIN SCA200 I /* 청소년보호자 */ ON I.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO
) E
AND E.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD = #{DATAA_CHG_SE_CD}
AND E.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{USER_ID} || '%'
AND (E.USER_NM = ENC_B64(#{USER_NM_ENCPT}) OR E.USER_NM = '____' || #{USER_NM})
AND E.MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{MENU_NM} || '%'
AND E.TOP_MENU_NM LIKE '%' || #{TOP_MENU_NM} || '%'
AND E.MDFCN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}
AND E.LAST_MDFR_ID LIKE '%' || #{WORKER} || '%'
ORDER BY E.MDFCN_DT DESC
OFFSET #{OFFSET_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY
